name: ASM Hydrasynth Explorer
description: ASM Hydrasynth Explorer portable 8-voice wave-morphing synthesizer: every controller of its owner's manual's MIDI CC chart.

sources.title: Hydrasynth Explorer Owner's Manual 2.2.0
sources.notes: MIDI CC chart, sorted by module (pages 94, 95 of the PDF), read by tools/profiles/asm/read-asm-cc.mjs from Hydrasynth_Explorer_Owners_Manual_2.2.0.pdf (sha256 7201137caa5ee8e2f7d5b5475a21f3d12b290db8852e0986f92a6cb20a4aa712), https://www.mecldata.com/download/asm/Hydrasynth_Explorer_Owners_Manual_2.2.0.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/asm/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/asm/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC chart, sent as that control change on the channel variable, its value the controller's 0 - 127: the chart prints no ranges. The instrument takes them when its Param RX (MIDI settings) is CC. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Its NRPN specification, published for the Keyboard and Desktop at firmware 1.5, is not taken to be the Explorer's: this is its manual's chart.

Left out, the bank select, wheel, pedal, volume and all notes off controllers: CC 0 Bank select MSB, CC 1 Modulation wheel., CC 7 Master Volume, CC 11 Expression pedal, CC 32 Bank select LSB, CC 64 Sustain pedal, CC 123 All notes off.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these controllers when its Param TX is CC
